published_ranges._hardened_nozzle_required: Yes: guide says hardened steel / ruby or wear-resistant nozzle is necessary (milled carbon fibres).

published_ranges._notes: Co-polyester based on CPE HG100 with carbon fibre; temperature stability up to 100 C. TDS: higher part cooling fan speed recommended only for bridges/overhangs.
